name: Aira (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Aira city emblem in green: a stylised bird-like device of green curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Aira, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 23 March 2010.

features.role: Aira city emblem — a stylised bird-like device of green curved strokes
